signInSubtitle.where: /login page, grey line under the congregation's name above the sign-in card

jsRequired.where: /login page, red notice inside the sign-in card shown only when the browser has JavaScript turned off

authorizedOnly.where: /login page, small grey line at the bottom of the sign-in card
authorizedOnly.context: 'library' = the music library of charts (sheet music)

legalNav.where: /login page, accessible name (aria-label) of the row of legal links at the bottom

legalPrivacy.where: /login page, link at the bottom to the privacy policy

legalTerms.where: /login page, link at the bottom to the terms of service

legalSmsConsent.where: /login page, link at the bottom to the SMS (text message) consent page

legalChangelog.where: /login page, link at the bottom to the list of app changes

legalAccessibility.where: /login page, link at the bottom to the accessibility statement

signInIncomplete.where: /login page, red error under the Google button when a sign-in attempt ended without signing in (popup closed, network)

signInFailed.where: /login page, red error under the Google button when Google sign-in threw an error

signingInClick.where: /login page, label of the main sign-in button while the sign-in is in progress

signInWithGoogle.where: /login page, label of the main sign-in button
signInWithGoogle.context: Google is the brand name of the account provider; keep it.

or.where: /login page, small divider word between the Google button and the 'set up this device' button

setUpDevice.where: /login page, button that reveals a QR code so a shared device (the band's iPads) can be signed in by scanning it with a signed-in phone
setUpDevice.who: musicians setting up a shared iPad

hide.where: /login page, small link under the revealed QR code that hides it again
hide.who: musicians setting up a shared iPad

qrSigningIn.where: Shared-device QR sign-in (on /login and Perform mode's sign-in screen): status shown on the iPad after the phone approved

qrSigningInAs.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: status on the iPad after the phone approved, naming who approved
qrSigningInAs.context: {userName} is the approving person's display name

qrGenerateFailed.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: message when the QR code could not be created

qrTryAgain.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: small link button that creates a new QR code after a failure

qrScanHint.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: instruction under the QR code

qrConnectionIssue.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: small yellow link under the QR code when the code could not be registered with the server

qrExpiresIn.where: Shared-device QR sign-in: tiny countdown under the QR code
qrExpiresIn.context: {minutes}:{seconds} is a clock-style countdown like 4:59; keep the colon between them.

approveChecking.where: Phone approval page (/qr/<code>, opened by scanning the iPad's QR code): loading message

approveExpiredTitle.where: Phone approval page: heading when the scanned code expired

approveExpiredBody.where: Phone approval page: explanation under 'Sign-in code expired'
approveExpiredBody.context: {orgName} is the congregation's or band's short name (e.g. 'CRC Music')

approveErrorTitle.where: Phone approval page: heading when approval failed

approveTryAgain.where: Phone approval page: fallback error text under 'Something Went Wrong'

approveGoHome.where: Phone approval page: button back to the home page after an error

approveNoToken.where: Phone approval page: error text under 'Something Went Wrong' when the phone's sign-in token is missing

approveFailed.where: Phone approval page: error text under 'Something Went Wrong' when the server refused the approval without a reason

approveSomethingWrong.where: Phone approval page: generic error text under 'Something Went Wrong'

approveSignedInTitle.where: Phone approval page: heading after the iPad was signed in

approveSignedInBody.where: Phone approval page: text under 'Signed In!'
approveSignedInBody.context: {userName} is the signed-in person's name or email (shown bold)

approveSigningInOnIpad.where: Phone approval page: status while approving
approveSigningInOnIpad.context: iPad is the device brand name; keep it.

approveTitle.where: Phone approval page: heading before approving

approveSignInPrompt.where: Phone approval page: text when the phone is not signed in yet

approveSignInWithGoogle.where: Phone approval page: button to sign in on the phone first

approveTapToSignInAs.where: Phone approval page: text above the approve button
approveTapToSignInAs.context: {userName} is the phone user's name or email (shown bold)

approveButton.where: Phone approval page: large approve button

authErrorTitle.where: /auth-error page heading (shown after a sign-in redirect loop)

authErrorHint.where: /auth-error page, text above the 'Refresh Session' button

authErrorRefresh.where: /auth-error page, button that signs out and lets the user sign in again
